items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Did you ever play with Andre and Le Fay?

ctx.x: In fact, Foss was with the Dawn of Busters, Al White and all of them.

Did you ever play with Andre and Le Fay? Yeah, he played fine piano. I never really get to hear him except on some homemade record. Yeah, he was real good. He was playing with Johnny Dutroy for a long time. And what about Howard Reed? Did you ever play with him? A trumpet player? No. A trumpet player. See, I may have a good... Yeah, he played with Foss for a while. Yeah, yeah. That's right. Yeah, yeah. He did. He and I did La Fay both played. Julian Lane, he died too. Yeah. He played a lot of T-God type of stuff.…

I saw him on St. Claude and Lee Fields there at the time. I miss my Schweigman's icon. There was an open air dance hall there. He had Shilang on drums, Frank Pinero on piano, Sherman on bass. He had Nina Pecconi on sax. He quit playing. He was What the World on the Ed Hall. And there was... He did, but you know Winstein on alto and Fazzola was on alto. Nina Pecconi was on tenor. And then they got... He was the Amaya Linebrier. He was on sax too. Fine sax man. He played Prim a while too. Yeah, I heard him on the…
